sermons.title: Sermon 29 | Christ Manifesting Himself to His People

scripture.verse: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?

sermons.title: Sermon 30 | The Power of the Holy Ghost

scripture.verse: The power of the Holy Ghost.

sermons.title: Sermon 31 | The Desire of the Soul in Spiritual Darkness

scripture.verse: With my soul have I desired thee in the night.

sermons.title: Sermon 32 | The Necessity of Increased Faith

scripture.verse: And the apostle said unto the Lord, increase our faith.
He shall choose our inheritance for us.
For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of; for necessity is laid upon me; yea woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel.

sermons.title: Sermon 35 | God's People in the Furnace

scripture.verse: I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
That clouds are the dust of his feet.
Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound.
